verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for an online filing and tracking service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no user-configurable automations, scheduled jobs or background agents. The docketing feature only tracks status, and the authenticated API (api.uspto.gov) and the direct Workbench API calls are developer building blocks rather than a product-provided automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
